WITH year_total_1998 AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        c_customer_id AS customer_id,
        c_first_name AS customer_first_name,
        c_last_name AS customer_last_name,
        c_preferred_cust_flag AS customer_preferred_cust_flag,
        c_birth_country AS customer_birth_country,
        c_login AS customer_login,
        c_email_address AS customer_email_address,
        d_year AS dyear,
        SUM(ss_ext_list_price - ss_ext_discount_amt) AS year_total,
        's' AS sale_type
    FROM customer
    JOIN store_sales ON customer.c_customer_sk = store_sales.ss_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    WHERE date_dim.d_year = 1998
    GROUP BY
        customer.c_customer_id,
        customer.c_first_name,
        customer.c_last_name,
        customer.c_preferred_cust_flag,
        customer.c_birth_country,
        customer.c_login,
        customer.c_email_address,
        date_dim.d_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        c_customer_id,
        c_first_name,
        c_last_name,
        c_preferred_cust_flag,
        c_birth_country,
        c_login,
        c_email_address,
        d_year,
        SUM(ws_ext_list_price - ws_ext_discount_amt),
        'w' AS sale_type
    FROM customer
    JOIN web_sales ON customer.c_customer_sk = web_sales.ws_bill_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim ON web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    WHERE date_dim.d_year = 1998
    GROUP BY
        customer.c_customer_id,
        customer.c_first_name,
        customer.c_last_name,
        customer.c_preferred_cust_flag,
        customer.c_birth_country,
        customer.c_login,
        customer.c_email_address,
        date_dim.d_year
),
year_total_1999 AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        c_customer_id AS customer_id,
        c_first_name AS customer_first_name,
        c_last_name AS customer_last_name,
        c_preferred_cust_flag AS customer_preferred_cust_flag,
        c_birth_country AS customer_birth_country,
        c_login AS customer_login,
        c_email_address AS customer_email_address,
        d_year AS dyear,
        SUM(ss_ext_list_price - ss_ext_discount_amt) AS year_total,
        's' AS sale_type
    FROM customer
    JOIN store_sales ON customer.c_customer_sk = store_sales.ss_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    WHERE date_dim.d_year = 1998 + 1
    GROUP BY
        customer.c_customer_id,
        customer.c_first_name,
        customer.c_last_name,
        customer.c_preferred_cust_flag,
        customer.c_birth_country,
        customer.c_login,
        customer.c_email_address,
        date_dim.d_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        c_customer_id,
        c_first_name,
        c_last_name,
        c_preferred_cust_flag,
        c_birth_country,
        c_login,
        c_email_address,
        d_year,
        SUM(ws_ext_list_price - ws_ext_discount_amt),
        'w' AS sale_type
    FROM customer
    JOIN web_sales ON customer.c_customer_sk = web_sales.ws_bill_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim ON web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    WHERE date_dim.d_year = 1998 + 1
    GROUP BY
        customer.c_customer_id,
        customer.c_first_name,
        customer.c_last_name,
        customer.c_preferred_cust_flag,
        customer.c_birth_country,
        customer.c_login,
        customer.c_email_address,
        date_dim.d_year
)
SELECT
    ratio_data.customer_id,
    ratio_data.customer_first_name,
    ratio_data.customer_last_name,
    ratio_data.customer_email_address
FROM (
    SELECT
        year_1999.customer_id,
        year_1999.customer_first_name,
        year_1999.customer_last_name,
        year_1999.customer_email_address,
        year_1999.store_second_total / year_1998.store_first_total AS store_ratio,
        year_1999.web_second_total / year_1998.web_first_total AS web_ratio
    FROM (
        SELECT
            store_first.customer_id,
            store_first.year_total AS store_first_total,
            web_first.year_total AS web_first_total
        FROM year_total_1998 AS store_first
        JOIN year_total_1998 AS web_first
            ON store_first.customer_id = web_first.customer_id
            AND store_first.sale_type = 's'
            AND web_first.sale_type = 'w'
            AND store_first.dyear = 1998
            AND web_first.dyear = 1998
        WHERE store_first.year_total > 0
            AND web_first.year_total > 0
    ) AS year_1998
    JOIN (
        SELECT
            store_second.customer_id,
            store_second.customer_first_name,
            store_second.customer_last_name,
            store_second.customer_email_address,
            store_second.year_total AS store_second_total,
            web_second.year_total AS web_second_total
        FROM year_total_1999 AS store_second
        JOIN year_total_1999 AS web_second
            ON store_second.customer_id = web_second.customer_id
            AND store_second.sale_type = 's'
            AND web_second.sale_type = 'w'
            AND store_second.dyear = 1998 + 1
            AND web_second.dyear = 1998 + 1
    ) AS year_1999
        ON year_1998.customer_id = year_1999.customer_id
) AS ratio_data
WHERE ratio_data.web_ratio > ratio_data.store_ratio
ORDER BY
    ratio_data.customer_id,
    ratio_data.customer_first_name,
    ratio_data.customer_last_name,
    ratio_data.customer_email_address
LIMIT 100
